title: Axian Telecom taps Oracle to unify its ERP across all operations
raw_text:
Pan-African infrastructure and services group Axian Telecom announced on Monday it has signed a partnership deal with Oracle to unify its ERP across its portfolio.
In a LinkedIn post, Axian said it is standardizing its processes, data, and operating models with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, which will enable AI-driven capabilities across its operations, including Yas, TowerCo of Africa, STELLARIX, zuku, MVola and Mixx.
Axian said the unified ERP will provide a strong digital core to deliver stronger governance, real-time enterprise visibility, and faster, insight-led decision-making across its finance and supply chains, enabling its teams to act with greater speed and precision.
“This program is a core enabler of our NEXT 2030 strategy and will provide the unified operational foundation we need as we continue to scale, diversify, and grow across Africa,” the post said.
Axian also said the Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP will be rolled out in phases, starting with its operations in Tanzania. The system is expected to go live later this year.
author: John Tanner
